about: Probe edges no graph fact can account for, each with its reason (ROADMAP Q-025; Julian, 2026-10-18: no probe edge lost without a written reason). Reviewed like code: each entry is a claim about HORDE's source at `commit`, citing the lines that show it; the gate ignores the whole file for any other commit, so a stale reason can never pass. Keyed 'src kind dst' as tools/parity.mjs reports them.

explained.file:h2/harness/harness.mjs import miss:: Comment, not code: line 9 is the file's doc comment showing how others import it (`import { ... } from '../h2/harness/harness.mjs'`); the crawl reads imports from code only (Julian, Q-023).
explained.file:src/gui/gui.html embeds miss:${buil: Configuration: CMakeLists.txt lines 106-111 embed gui.html only with -DHYPERSAW_GUI2=OFF; the declared Release configuration the crawl ran embeds gui2.html, which the crawl has (gui2.html generates gui_html.h, as input). The probe does not read CMake conditions.
explained.file:tools/build_flags_check.py referenc: Missed by the crawl, a real use: line 133 lists "CMakeLists.txt" among glob patterns the check scans, and line 306 looks it up by key in the dict of repo files read at lines 132-139. A name used as a pattern and a dict key, not a path the crawl can follow.
explained.file:tools/gen_lab_index.py generates fi: Probe error: line 177 writes D / "index.html" with D = ROOT / "docs/design" (line 51), i.e. docs/design/index.html, not the root index.html.
explained.file:tools/gen_lab_index.py reference fi: Probe error: line 72 compares a lab file's name with "index.html" inside docs/design (f.parent != D); it names no root file.
explained.file:tools/h2_ab.mjs generates file:inde: Probe error: line 296 writes join(outDir, 'index.html'), a run's output folder, not the root index.html (the crawl's next-to-the-file rule for bare names exists for exactly this case).
explained.file:tools/labharness/sandbox_check.mjs: Probe and crawl both misread line 204: it writes a stub at join(fx, 'tools/registry_decl.py'), inside the scratch fixture fx (defined at line 189), not the repo's file. The probe calls it a write to the repo file; the crawl a reference to it, because a literal with a / resolves from the repo root whatever it is joined onto (a known crawl false positive, recorded in Q-025's trace).

explained.file:tools/test_identity_check.py refere: Missed by the crawl, a real use: line 75 binds CMAKE = "CMakeLists.txt", passed to git ls-files from ROOT at line 168. The crawl reads a literal where it is used, not through a constant.
explained.file:tools/weakening_check.py reference: Missed by the crawl, a real use: SCOPE (line 160) is the pathspec list passed to git ls-files (line 293), run from ROOT by scan(ROOT) (line 968), which then reads every listed file, the root CMakeLists.txt among them. (Line 570 is a separate use: a key of LAYOUT, the files its must-fail controls write into a scratch git repo.)
